welcome.title: OmniView
welcome.sub: A native all-format viewer that does not depend on Office, Photoshop, AutoCAD or FFmpeg.
welcome.body:
PDF, Office, Markdown, text, images, audio/video, archives, code, databases, 3D, CAD, GIS, fonts and more.
Install only the plugins you need.
welcome.hint: Tip: drag files or folders into the window. Plugins are downloaded on demand.
